BrochureContent.Content:
Why pay Galway City prices when you can enjoy exceptional value without compromising on convenience? This delightful two bedroom semi-detached residence offers the perfect opportunity to step onto the property ladder, down size in comfort, or invest in a thriving location.

Situated in the heart of Glenamaddy town this charming home is within walking distance of an excellent range of local amenities, including shops, schools, cafes, sporting facilities and essential services, making everyday living both easy and convenient. 

The property boasts bright, spacious living and sleeping accommodation throughout. Parking is available directly outside the front door, with the added bonus of free on street parking. To the rear, a private patio area provides the perfect space to relax, entertain or enjoy outdoor dining.

Accommodation comprises an inviting entrance hallway, a comfortable sitting room to the front of the property, a bright kitchen and dining area to the rear, a family bathroom, a spacious single bedroom completing the accommodation of this well presented home.

Priced at just 165,000 Euro this property represents outstanding value for a home of such quality in a highly convenient location. Whether you are a first time buyer, investor, or looking for a manageable home in a welcoming community this property is sure to impress.

For further information or to arrange your private viewings, please make contact with the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where everything we touch turns to SOLD.
